name: iacg-risk
purpose: Risk rubric for a mission's findings: correctness bugs hard-block (never ship), security posture is fix-or-accept-by-name, style is advisory. Makes 'usable with accepted security findings' legible.
never_do: let an aggregate failed state stand alone without naming each failure tier
call a checkov security finding a code bug or a tflint ERROR mere style
present code with a correctness finding as ready to ship
accept a finding itself (acceptance is a named human decision)

provenance.source_reference: Owner directive I2: checkov = security accept-or-fix; tflint ERROR = possible code bug; never ship a known bug. Presentation prototyped as a skill before gate code.
